ENG: What's a Study Day Worth?

The voice of [educator.Custom2('MyCharacterIntroduction', ROOT.Char)] drones on and on as [educator.GetSheHe] lectures me for the umpteenth time on the proper ways of a [ROOT.Char.GetLadyLord], interspersed with austere quotes from the [educator.GetFaith.ReligiousText|U].

ENG: As I turn another page, I stare forlornly at the other children of the [ROOT.Char.Custom('GetCourt')] playing outside. The laughter, the joyful screams... I look back at the copy of [ROOT.Char.GetFaith.ReligiousText|U] sitting on the table.

ENG: \n\nCertainly, this is all very important for my future, but... Would anyone really notice if I snuck out for once — or maybe twice — to play?

ENG: [child.GetSheHe|U] Knows This Room

[child.GetSheHe|U] took [child.GetHerHis] first steps in these very quarters, but that was long ago. The many years spent abroad as a hostage must have wiped the memories from [child.GetHerHis] young mind.

Once again, [child.GetSheHe] looks around and sighs.

У меня в груди все сжимается, когда я вижу, как [Select_CString(child.IsFemale, 'моя любимая', 'мой любимый' )] [child.Custom('GetDaughterSon')], [child.GetFirstName], недоуменно смотрит на окружающие [child.GetHerHis] стены, не узнавая их.

[child.GetSheHe|U] вновь осматривается и вздыхает.

Swoje pierwsze kroki stawiał[Select_CString(child.IsFemale, 'a', '' )] właśnie w tych komnatach, ale to było dawno temu. Wiele lat spędzonych za granicą jako zakładni[Select_CString(child.IsFemale, 'czka', 'k' )] musiało wymazać wspomnienia z [child.GetHerHis] młodego umysłu.

Po raz kolejny rozgląda się i wzdycha.

ENG: I need to talk to [child.GetHerHim].
[child.GetSheHe|U]'ll get over it.
